name: Shiny Text

bandWidth.description: Width of the bright band, as a percentage of the gradient.

pauseOnHover.description: Pause the sweep while the pointer or focus is over the text.

disabled.description: Show a plain solid colour with no shimmer.

a11y: The text is never split into spans; screen readers read it once, normally.
The base colour must pass 4.5:1 against the background on its own, since the band only briefly raises local contrast.
Reduced motion keeps the band fixed at 50%, so the surface still reads as metallic but does not move.
Forced-colors mode drops the gradient and paints the text in CanvasText.
